negative_regimes.microbench_note: Duplicates resident weights into separate host+GPU buffers inside the same 24 GiB unified RAM pool, triggering swap pressure and wasted LPDDR5X copy traffic
Uniform activation profile (Gini=0.026, top-20% covers 21.2% vs corpus power-law) defeats hot-neuron locality, incurring 64-layer CPU scatter-gather sync overhead
Wins prefetch-hit microbenchmark (99.2% vs 91.5% hit rate) via 8-layer staging ring, but overflows 22.50 GiB usable VRAM (23.86 GiB demand) and evicts live KV cache
